title: Replacement Haul-Away Credit for Northgate Protect Settlements — Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Entitlement.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a customer whose Northgate Protect claim was settled by replacement or by reimbursement for an item of a merchandise category, and who then buys an item of the same category on a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order with a haul-away charge above zero, placed zero to ninety days after that settlement, is owed a replacement haul-away credit for the old item the claim settled, booked as one refund of the haul-away charge with reason fee refund.

**Fee refunds on such an order.** For the haul-away charge of a Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order placed zero to ninety days after a Northgate Protect claim settlement that replaced or reimbursed an item of a merchandise category the order carries, and only for that charge, the replacement haul-away credit is refunded as this rule states, whatever tender paid the order; on every other order and for every other fee, a fee is refunded only as stated in the returns rule and the fulfilment and cancellation rule, or in the rule written for that charge.

**Tender.** The amount of the credit is the same whatever tender paid the order. It is booked at the care desk only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it. On every other order the same amount applies; its posting to the Northgate Card, Northgate Cash or gift card ledger is made by a human representative to whom the customer is handed over with the reason policy not covered, and nothing is booked at the care desk.

**Invocation — `credit_replacement_haul_away_849732e1`.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books one refund of part or all of the order's haul-away charge, credited to the external payment card that paid the order and recorded against that haul-away charge with the reason fee refund; the net amount paid on the order goes down by the credit, and the customer sees the credit on the order and on the card at once. An order not paid in full by an external card, or with Northgate Cash or a gift card redeemed on it, is refused and nothing is recorded.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the reference number of the Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order, read from the customer's order lookup | identifier |
| `fee_event_id` | the reference number of the haul-away charge on that order, read from the order's line and fee lookup | identifier |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the credit refunded on the haul-away charge | US dollars, a positive number with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text starting with "Credited" means the credit is booked and gives `refund_event_id`, `order_id`, `fee_event_id`, `credit_amount_usd` and `amount_paid_usd` (the order's net amount paid after the credit), amounts with 2 decimals. A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an amount not above zero or with more than 2 decimal places, an order that does not exist, a reference that is not a haul-away charge on that order, or an order refused on its tender.
